import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.size': 9,
    'mathtext.fontset': 'cm',
    'axes.linewidth': 0.8,
    'xtick.major.width': 0.6,
    'ytick.major.width': 0.6,
    'xtick.direction': 'in',
    'ytick.direction': 'in',
    'xtick.major.pad': 3,
    'ytick.major.pad': 3,
})

p = np.linspace(0.005, 0.5, 500)

def P_correct(p, K):
    return p / (1.0 - (1.0 - p)**K)

configs = [
    (2,  'K=2 (h $\\approx$ full)', '#2ca02c', '-'),
    (5,  'K=5 (h=5)',               '#1f77b4', '-'),
    (8,  'K=8 (h=2)',               '#ff7f0e', '-'),
    (25, 'K=25',                    '#d62728', '-'),
]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5, 3.5))

# shaded region below 0.5
ax.axhspan(0, 0.5, color='#ffcccc', alpha=0.35, zorder=0)
ax.axhline(0.5, color='gray', ls='--', lw=0.8, zorder=1)
ax.text(0.48, 0.52, 'random chance', ha='right', va='bottom',
        fontsize=7.5, color='gray', style='italic')
ax.text(0.20, 0.25, 'majority of updates have incorrect sign',
        ha='center', va='center', fontsize=8, color='#cc4444', alpha=0.8)

for K, label, color, ls in configs:
    y = P_correct(p, K)
    ax.plot(p, y, color=color, ls=ls, lw=1.8, label=label, zorder=2)

# operating point: p=0.125, K=8
p_op = 0.125
K_op = 8
y_op = P_correct(p_op, K_op)
print(f"Operating point: p={p_op}, K={K_op}, P(correct)={y_op:.4f}")

ax.plot(p_op, y_op, 'o', color='#ff7f0e', ms=7, zorder=5,
        markeredgecolor='black', markeredgewidth=0.8)
ax.annotate(
    f'Operating point\nP(correct) = {y_op:.1%}',
    xy=(p_op, y_op), xytext=(p_op + 0.10, y_op + 0.12),
    fontsize=7.5, ha='left', va='bottom',
    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='black', lw=0.8),
    bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', fc='white', ec='gray', lw=0.5, alpha=0.9),
    zorder=6
)

ax.set_xlabel('Episode success rate $p$')
ax.set_ylabel('$P$(correct sign $|$ update)')
ax.set_xlim(0, 0.52)
ax.set_ylim(0, 1.02)
ax.legend(loc='lower right', fontsize=8, framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='gray')

fig.tight_layout(pad=0.5)
fig.savefig('/root/cost-verify-agent-rl/artifacts/figures/fig_theoretical_sign_prob.pdf',
            dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
fig.savefig('/root/cost-verify-agent-rl/artifacts/figures/fig_theoretical_sign_prob.png',
            dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
print('Saved.')
PYEOF
